name: Rings of Living Shield
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This pair of rings appears to be rings of friend shield. Instead of allowing the casting of shield other the rings act as a constant one way connection between the wearers, resulting in one ring being a Sender’s Ring and the other being a Receiver’s Ring. All damage dealt to the wearer of the Sender’s Ring is inflicted instead upon the wearer of the Receiver’s Ring.

These rings can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon them, which render the rings non-magical. If either wearer dies, the rings may also be freely removed from both wearers.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of friend shield

Identification DC 35
False Identification DC 25
